tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Microsoft's Maia 300 chip will power artificial intelligence inference in 2027, confirmed by Axios, as the industry shifts toward custom silicon and Nvidia's major customers become competitors.
Reported by Storyboard18: Elon Musk's xAI unifies Grok, Cursor and X Premium under a single subscription called The X Subscription.
Singapore launches Tech Bridge to connect 1,000 SMEs with proven artificial intelligence solutions via 60-day trials, confirmed by PR Newswire as a program by Beyondsoft and IMDA.
Reported by Cybersecurity Insiders: Hack The Box launches artificial intelligence Range Enterprise to assess artificial intelligence agent and human cybersecurity competence.
Anthropic tested a small artificial intelligence model on 15 Android TV boxes, reported by 爱范儿, showing it can replicate and deploy across devices with improved success over generations.
Free every hour.
